rules.description: Windows-style Home and End keys, with Terminal support
Ctrl+Alt+T opens a new Terminal window everywhere

to.shell_command:
osascript -e 'if application "Terminal" is running then
    tell application "Terminal"
        if (count of windows) > 0 then
            set priorBounds to bounds of front window
            do script ""
            activate
            set {leftEdge, topEdge, rightEdge, bottomEdge} to priorBounds
            set bounds of front window to {leftEdge + 24, topEdge + 24, rightEdge + 24, bottomEdge + 24}
        else
            activate
        end if
    end tell
else
    tell application "Terminal" to activate
end if'
